posts.title: Stop telling people to delete their social media
posts.description: In 2017, I deleted my Facebook account. It was triggered by an HN comment that I cannot for the life of me find, but at the time it felt like the right thing to do. Everybody smart on the internet was saying social media was rotting our brains and the only way out was to get rid of it. Almost a decade later I can say it plainly: it was a mistake.
